en.headline: HK Electric cuts November fuel adjustment charge by 4.2 cents
en.dek: The average net tariff falls 2.2 per cent to 183 cents per kilowatt-hour, reflecting fuel costs from July to September under the deferral mechanism.
body: Hong Kong Electric announced that its fuel adjustment charge for November will be 55.1 cents per kilowatt-hour, a reduction of 4.2 cents from October.
Combined with the basic tariff, the average net electricity tariff for November will be 183 cents per kilowatt-hour, 2.2 per cent lower than the previous month.

The company said the monthly adjustment is subject to a deferral effect, so the November figure primarily reflects actual fuel costs incurred between July and September. A spokesperson noted that international oil and gas prices remain volatile and that future charges will depend on global fuel price trends.
CLP Power, which supplies Kowloon and the New Territories, separately raised its November fuel adjustment charge by 1.2 cents to 47.4 cents per kilowatt-hour.

zh.headline: 港燈下調11月燃料調整費4.2仙 淨電費跌2.2%
zh.dek: 11月平均淨電費為每度183仙，主要反映7至9月燃料成本；中電同期則上調1.2仙至47.4仙。
body: 香港電燈宣布，11月份燃料調整費為每度電55.1仙，較10月下調4.2仙。
連同基本電費計算，11月平均淨電費為每度電183仙，較上月減少2.2%。
港燈表示，燃料調整費設有遞延效應，11月收費主要反映今年7月至9月的實際燃料成本。發言人指國際油氣價格仍波動，未來調整將視乎全球燃料價格走勢。
供電九龍及新界的中電則將11月燃料調整費上調1.2仙，至每度電47.4仙。
